summary: prior_nonconstenv_2var_agree_until at K=0 is FALSE (not just hard to prove). Counterexample: Z with is_even, (x,t)=(4,0), (x',t')=(2,0). Depth-2 1-var NFs at 4 and 2 agree (translation symmetry mod 2), but depth-2 2-var NFs at [4,0] and [2,0] differ because exists w in (0,4) even (w=2) but no even w in (0,2). The false theorem propagates through prior_2var_transfer_until to all K values. Fix requires restructuring existPart_succ_n1_bypass at k>=1 to not use prior_2var_transfer_until, using VecEA-mediated bracket formulas instead.

blockers.description: prior_nonconstenv_2var_agree_until at K=0 is FALSE, AND the entire theorem is false at all K (recursion bottoms out at K=0). Counterexample: Z with is_even, M=N=Z, t=t'=0, x=4, x'=2. The fix requires bypassing prior_2var_transfer_until in existPart_succ_n1_bypass.
blockers.what_failed: The theorem statement itself is false. Depth-2 2-var NF agreement on non-constant environments does NOT follow from depth-2 1-var endpoint agreements on Prior structures. Zone-3 existentials (witnesses between endpoints) cannot be transferred between structures even with Prior-UZ/SZ.
blockers.what_was_tried: Analysis of the goal at K=0 sorry (line 869). Zone decomposition shows zones 1,2,4,5 transfer via exist_transfer_from_full_agree on h_x/h_t. Zone 3 requires exists w in (t,x) with preds matching to transfer to exists w' in (t',x') with preds matching. This is provably false (Z counterexample). The code AFTER the sorry also calls zone_compatible_witness at d=1 (sorry) and nf_eval_from_lower_agree at d=0 (sorry), both of which are also false for the same reason.
blockers.impact: existPart_succ_n1_bypass at k>=1 backward direction is unprovable with current architecture. All K values of prior_nonconstenv_2var_agree_until/since are broken.
blockers.suggested_fix: NEW PLAN: Modify existPart_succ_n1_bypass to use VecEA2 bracket formulas for the backward direction at k>=1 (same pattern as k=0 enriched bypass). The formula A encodes zone-3 witnesses using BracketFormula, which guarantees witnesses are in the correct interval by construction. The bracket point types use char_fn at appropriate depths. This bypasses PriorComposition entirely.
